title: AnyAssistant community catalog
description: The index of themes and plugins people share: what AnyAssistant reads to list, install, update and remove them (docs/comunidad.md).

format.description: The index's format. AnyAssistant reads up to 1: a newer format is refused whole, so a breaking change means a new number (and a new index for older versions).

updated.description: When the index was last changed (YYYY-MM-DD). Only for people.

kind.description: A theme (HTML and CSS for the screen) or a plugin (Python code the server runs).

id.description: Its folder's name once installed: lowercase letters, numbers, - and _. Unique per kind; never a system theme's or plugin's (eyes, orb, minimal, bedside; memory, pairing…: AnyAssistant refuses those).

version.description: A version people can read (1.0.0, 2.1…). An update exists when the catalog's is greater than the installed one (PEP 440 order; if not comparable, when it differs).

descriptions.description: The description in other languages ({"es": "…"}): the one in the active language is shown, else description. bin/anyassistant community entry takes them from the package's locales.

homepage.description: Where to read more (the package's folder in the repository, or its own page).

screenshot.description: Themes: an https:// address of a PNG or JPEG (3 MB at most). The server fetches it and shows it; the pages load nothing from outside.

min_version.description: The oldest AnyAssistant it works with: the number in its VERSION («280-9e919ad» → 280; Settings shows it). A version in development (no VERSION file) fits anything.

files.description: Every file of the package: a theme needs theme.json, theme.html and theme.css (and only files of the kinds a theme may have); a plugin needs plugin.json and __init__.py. Each is downloaded, checked against its SHA-256 and only then written; one missing or different and nothing is installed.

path.description: Where it goes inside the package's folder: plain relative paths (locales/es.json), no «..».

url.description: Where to download it from, https:// (raw.githubusercontent.com for a file in the repository). 10 MB at most per file, 50 MB per package.

sha256.description: Its SHA-256, in hexadecimal (shasum -a 256 <file>, or bin/anyassistant community entry).
